'''Fernando Rita''' (born 30 November 1961) is a Spanish [[sailing (sport)|sailor]]. He competed in the [[Sailing at the 1992 Summer Olympics – Star|Star event]] at the [[1992 Summer Olympics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.olympedia.org/athletes/63462 |title=Fernando Rita |work=Olympedia |access-date=23 June 2020}}</ref> In the [[Snipe (dinghy)|Snipe class]] he was third at the [[Commodore Hub E. Isaacks and O'Leary Trophies|World's]] in 1999, [[Snipe European Championship|European champion]] in 1986, and third in 1988.
